interpretive.purpose: GitHub profile repo for the LogicallyTyped org/user. Its README.md is the special-cased file GitHub renders on the org/user profile page; it is a short bio plus a pointer to work-activity-log, which is where the actual sanitized activity log lives.
consumers: Anyone browsing github.com/LogicallyTyped (recruiters, collaborators, visitors) via the rendered profile page

components.name: README.md
components.responsibility: Bio and engineering-patterns summary rendered on the GitHub profile page; links out to work-activity-log for detailed activity.

interpretive.data_flow_summary: No data flow; this is a documentation-only repository with a single static file rendered by GitHub's profile-README feature.
operational_notes: Content edits to README.md take effect immediately on the public github.com/LogicallyTyped profile page for any visitor — there is no staging or review step.
